description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers analysing an external reference repository (competitor, peer, inspiration) and producing a comparison and adoption plan, including the renamed analyze-repo door. Should-not-trigger covers the neighbours that own a different surface: /analyze:pr (a pull request), /analyze:inbox (dropped artifacts in agents/tmp), /project:analyze (this project), /analyze:roadmap-repos (repositories a roadmap names) and plain library recommendations.
